name: generate_rebar_curves
author: hprebar
title: Convert 3D Curve Networks into Native Revit Rebar
description: Converts 3D curve networks from Grasshopper into native Revit standard Rebar elements inside a host concrete element.
notes: Creates standard Rebar from curve segments in Revit host element.

hostElementId.description: Element ID of host concrete beam, column, or foundation.

rebarCurves.description: List of polyline curve sets defining rebar centerlines in meters.

barDiameterMm.description: Target rebar nominal diameter in millimeters.

diameterToleranceMm.description: Maximum allowable difference in millimeters between target diameter and available Revit RebarBarType.
